scope: Every public 2025-2026 method in baseline-register.v2.csv, excluding the proposed AgentEnhance method.

coverage.note: Repository availability is the state frozen in the local register. A live release recheck was attempted on 2026-09-03 but the web backend returned HTTP 404, so no missing-repository claim is treated as current verification.

groups.next_gate: Complete and independently audit all three frozen seeds.
groups.numeric_policy: Admit only complete local same-protocol results.

groups.next_gate: Pass the already frozen method-specific model and lifecycle gates before full runs.
groups.numeric_policy: Keep cells empty until complete local runs are accepted.

groups.next_gate: Freeze immutable source revisions and complete static adapter audits.
groups.numeric_policy: Report in the matched MemGallery table, never mix with WMA values.

groups.next_gate: Resolve and freeze official repository commits, then design fail-closed WMA adapters.
groups.numeric_policy: No official-paper score substitution; failed adapters remain in the appendix.

groups.next_gate: Finish the separately frozen causal-memory reproduction.
groups.numeric_policy: Keep causal-safety evidence separate from WMA ranking.

groups.next_gate: Recheck author or official repositories; freeze a commit only if runnable method code is publicly available.
groups.numeric_policy: Until code is verified, retain source-reported values only as separated reproduction targets.

groups.next_gate: Reproduce only after primary matched tracks have sufficient accepted baselines.
groups.numeric_policy: Never use different-benchmark numbers for an overall SOTA claim on WMA.

groups.next_gate: Use only for scoped transfer or discussion experiments.
groups.numeric_policy: No direct ranking against the WMA primary estimand.

groups.next_gate: Monitor for public runnable artifacts; otherwise retain bibliographic context only.
groups.numeric_policy: No numeric cells in local-reproduction tables.

selection_rule: Execute groups in order subject to each method's frozen gate. Within an executable group, retain every registered result including null, reversed, failed, and inconclusive outcomes; do not prioritize from observed benchmark values.
model_cleanup_rule: Only a project-owned, run-specific, immutable-revision model cache may be deleted after that reproduction and its evidence archive are terminal-accepted. Shared or pre-existing models are never cleanup targets.
